title: panax pseudoginseng var. major
intro: Panax pseudoginseng var. major, commonly known as Korean ginseng or Sancho, is a plant species belonging to the genus Panax, which is native to East Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve cognitive function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Panax pseudoginseng var. major are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress, improve sleep quality, and enhance physical performance. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ginsenosides, a group of triterpene saponins, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
